final: WITH per_type AS (SELECT e.type, AVG(b.spent * 1.0 / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE b.spent <> 0 GROUP BY e.type) SELECT type, avg_ratio, avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM per_type) AS distance_from_mean FROM per_type
